# Doc templates

Reusable skeletons for AgentKeep. Prefer editing numbered docs in `/docs` for live product truth; use these when starting a new decision or RFC.

| Template | Use |
|----------|-----|
| [ADR-template.md](ADR-template.md) | Architecture decisions |
| [RFC-template.md](RFC-template.md) | Larger product/tech proposals |
| [Endpoint-spec-template.md](Endpoint-spec-template.md) | Per-route deep dive before OpenAPI edit |
| [Incident-template.md](Incident-template.md) | Postmortems later |
